decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted numbered 9934-201, 9934-205, 9934-210, 9934-212 C, 9934-215 D, 9934-220, CgMs/11944, Design & Access Statement and Noise Impact Assessment Received 16/11/2010 and 9934-211 E Received 04/01/2011 therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - The 3 air conditioning units hereby approved shall be operated on the premises between the hours of 07:00-23:00 Monday-Sunday only and at no other times.
description: Installation of plant equipment comprising 3 floor mounted air conditioning units and a condenser unit within a timber fence enclosure to the rear of the site.
